description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smart Assist is Smartsheet's AI agent for work management, used by enterprise customers to analyze, create, and act on their work. Agent Engineering owns the runtime layer behind it: the orchestrator, core sub-agents, memory, context management, and the MCP integration that ties it together. We are accountable for how the agent thinks, acts, and remembers in production.

We build the agent harness as a reusable platform so other teams can build, integrate, and evaluate agents on a shared foundation. We work four ways: harness engineering (tuning the agent loop for quality, latency, and cost), capability expansion (core agents, skills, and tools), platformizing (shared components and patterns), and keeping it running (on-call, security, cost, and access controls).

The role. You will own a significant part of the Smart Assist runtime (for example orchestration and agent loops, memory and context, long-running execution, or model readiness) and shape how agents are built on our harness through design reviews and guilds. You will make architecture calls, raise the bar for the team, and make it possible for other teams to build agents on the platform without us in the critical path.

You Will:

  • Own the design and evolution of an area of the runtime, including trade-offs between model decisions at runtime and deterministic code, and between prompt/context fixes and structural ones.
  • Lead harness engineering at depth: long-running and durable execution, checkpoints and persistent plans, inline and multi-agent patterns, memory architecture, model swaps, and cost and latency control at scale.
  • Drive platformization: define the reusable components, shared libraries, intent routing, agent registry and integration patterns that let other teams build and integrate agents quickly, and drive adoption across teams.
  • Shape the multi-agent architecture and the convergence of existing and new agents into one experience.
  • Define how quality is measured and enforced: offline gating, online monitoring, and the prompt-analysis loop, working with AI Platform on the shared evals platform.
  • Own operational excellence for Smart Assist: on-call health, post-incident reviews, security posture (including prompt injection and permission-aware access), cost control, and entitlement and access correctness.
  • Lead through POCs and ambiguity: frame problems, run time-boxed experiments, write decisions down, and bring the team and partners along.
  • Mentor SE I and II engineers through design and code review; help hire and onboard. Use AI tools in incident and on-call work, and show teammates how.
  • Partner with the EM, PMs, AI Experiences, AI Platform, MCP, and external partners on roadmap and dependencies.

You Have: 

  • 5+ years building and operating production systems, with deep Python and strong system design (distributed systems, durable state and long-running workflows, APIs, data modeling).
  • 2+ years building LLM agent systems in production, with real opinions from experience on context engineering, subagents, memory, tool design, async or deferred tools, and failure recovery.
  • Track record of designing evals that gate releases and of attributing production failures to the right layer (model, prompt, tool contract, context, environment), using calibrated LLM judges and online behavioral signals.
  • Experience building shared platforms or libraries that other teams adopt, and of influencing without authority.
  • Experience with MCP and agent skills or tools at scale; familiarity with agent-to-agent and multi-agent patterns.
  • Experience operating AI systems in production: observability, cost management, security and safety patterns (prompt injection mitigation, output validation, grounding, permission-aware retrieval).
  • Fluency with AI-assisted development and a point of view on how it changes engineering practice.
  • Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain trade-offs to executives and to engineers.
  • Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis.
  • Strong plus: model evaluation and swap tooling; Databricks or lakehouse data work; enterprise SaaS, permissions and entitlements; prior mentoring or tech-lead experience.

What success looks like:

  • First 90 days: understand the runtime and its failure modes, ship a meaningful improvement in your area, and publish a design or decision doc the team adopts.
  • First 6 months: deliver a measurable gain in reliability, latency, or cost per task in your area; land a reusable pattern or component adopted by at least one other team; and mentor at least one engineer to a visible growth step.

Why this role:

  • You own how Smart Assist behaves in production, with real users and a measurable quality bar, not a supporting slot on someone else's roadmap.
  • The problems are distinctive: enterprise-grade permissions and security, and one agent experience that works across a broad work-management product used by thousands of customers.
  • You build the harness as a platform. Other teams build on what you create, so your work multiplies across the product.
  • You work on the hard parts of production agents: long-running work, memory, context, and cost, on a team that values engineering rigor and diverse perspectives.

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
  • Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
  • Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
  • Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

US Base Salary Pay Range
$145,000—$210,000 USD

 

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.
